description: This file defines a Python class 'StrandsAgentsProcessor' that integrates Strands Agents into a Pipecat framework for handling conversational AI interactions. It manages both single-agent and multi-agent workflows, processing frames within a pipeline and invoking Strands Agents accordingly.
